name: phonemos
title: Phonemos
description: Connector that gives access to the Phonemos knowledge base from within YouTrack. Suggests Phonemos knowledge base articles on YouTrack Helpdesk tickets. Each person connects their own Phonemos account (OAuth2), and Phonemos permissions decide which pages they can open.
changeNotes: First release. Suggests Phonemos articles from the ticket summary, description, and the latest reporter comment, and adds a main-menu search of the connected site.

widgets.name: Suggested knowledge base articles
widgets.description: Suggests Phonemos articles for the current helpdesk ticket

widgets.name: Phonemos search
widgets.description: Search the Phonemos knowledge base and manage the connection
